hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *packages/*/lib/*.dart) jq -n --arg f "$f" '{systemMessage: ("Source changed: " + $f + " — check whether the corresponding package README.md (zarvan_core/README.md, zarvan_flutter/README.md, zarvan_cli/README.md) or the root CLAUDE.md needs updating to match.")}' ;; esac
